"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is an urgent need to modernize the federal government's legacy systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is an urgent need to recruit skilled technical personnel who can advance the adoption of innovation in the public sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration has done little to advance the goal of universal broadband coverage, at the cost of billions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Lack of broadband coverage hurts rural America, where farmers, ranchers, and small business people need connectivity to operate in real time with the world's producers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Almost ten million Americans have given up wired broadband connections in the last two years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions of Americans have never been connected to wired broadband.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for public-private partnerships to provide predictable support for connecting rural areas so that every American can fully participate in the global economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Public-private partnerships between NASA, the Department of Defense, and commercial companies have given us technological progress that has reduced the cost of accessing space.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Public-private partnerships between NASA, the Department of Defense, and commercial companies have extended America's space leadership in the commercial, civil, and national security spheres.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The entrepreneurship and innovation culture of the free market is revitalizing the nation's space capabilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The entrepreneurship and innovation culture of the free market is saving taxpayer money.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The entrepreneurship and innovation culture of the free market is advancing technology critical to maintain America's edge in space and in other fields.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
